transcript:
Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Rakesh? I'm calling from Aster Vale Pain Clinic about your knee pain enquiry.
Customer: No, there is no Rakesh here. This is a shop number.
Agent: Sir, we received an enquiry from this number yesterday for knee pain.
Customer: No, no, nobody here made any enquiry. Nobody here has any knee problem either. Wrong number.
Agent: Okay sir, sorry for the disturbance.
Customer: It's okay.

Agent: Hello ma'am, I'm Riya from Aster Vale Care. You had filled a form on our page. Tell me, what problem are you facing?
Customer: Yes, I filled it. I wanted a hair fall treatment. Do you do hair transplant?
Agent: Ma'am, we are a pain clinic. Do you have any pain, back, knee, neck, anything?
Customer: No, no pain at all. I'm completely fine, just hair fall. Nobody at home has pain also.
Agent: Okay ma'am, then our clinic won't be able to help with that.
Customer: Okay, thank you.

Agent: Hello, Aster Vale Pain Clinic, I'm Kabir. You enquired for pain treatment?
Customer: Yes, it's for my son. He has knee pain after football for two weeks.
Agent: How old is your son, ma'am?
Customer: He is twelve years old.
Agent: Ma'am, our clinic sees patients who are fifteen years or older. For a twelve-year-old we cannot book a consultation. Please consult a paediatric orthopaedic doctor.
Customer: Oh, okay. Fine, thank you.

Agent: Hello, Aster Vale Care, how can I help you?
Customer: Hi, this is Priya from the internal CRM team. This is just a test lead, we're checking the new dialer. Please mark it as test.
Agent: Okay Priya, noted, I'll mark this enquiry as a test.
Customer: Thanks, bye.

Agent: Hello sir, Aster Vale Pain Clinic. You enquired about back pain?
Customer: Yes, I have lower back pain for a year. But I live permanently in Toronto, I've been settled there for fifteen years.
Agent: Sir, our clinics are only in India. Will you be visiting India anytime?
Customer: No, I'm not coming to India, not this year or next year.
Agent: We can do an online video consultation with our doctor.
Customer: No, I don't want online. For pain I need a doctor to examine me physically. Online is of no use to me.
Agent: Okay sir, understood.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Care. You enquired for your back pain?
Customer: Yes, I have back pain for six months.
Agent: Our doctor can see you this week. Shall I call you tomorrow at 5 to fix a time?
Customer: Okay.
Agent: Also, the consultation is 1000 rupees, valid for 15 days.
Customer: Actually, you people have called me four times already. Please don't call me again. Remove my number from your list.
Agent: Ma'am, I was only...
Customer: No, please, do not call me. I'm not interested.

Agent: Hello sir, Aster Vale Care. You enquired for neck pain?
Customer: Yes, neck pain for three months. But I'm in Jaipur now for work for two months.
Agent: No problem, sir. We can do a video consultation with Dr. Naman. The doctor will see your reports online.
Customer: That works. When?
Agent: Thursday, the 15th, at 6 PM on video call. Shall I book it?
Customer: Yes, book it for Thursday 6 PM.
Agent: Done sir, your online consultation is confirmed for Thursday 6 PM. I'll send the video link on WhatsApp.
Customer: Okay, thank you.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Care. You had an appointment yesterday at 11 with Dr. Mira but you couldn't come.
Customer: Yes, sorry, my knee pain was bad and there was nobody to drop me. I still want to come.
Agent: No problem. Shall I move your appointment to Friday, the 16th, at 12:30?
Customer: Yes, Friday 12:30 is fine. Please change it.
Agent: Done ma'am, your appointment is rescheduled to Friday 12:30 PM.
Customer: Okay, thank you.

Agent: Hello?
Agent: Hello, am I audible?
Customer: Hello... who... [noise]
Agent: Sir, I'm calling from Aster Vale...
Customer: [inaudible]
Agent: Hello? Hello?

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Care, about your shoulder pain enquiry.
Customer: I'm not interested, your treatment is too expensive.
Agent: Ma'am, the consultation is only 1000 rupees and procedures have zero-cost EMI. The doctor will examine you first.
Customer: EMI is there? Okay, then that's manageable. My shoulder pain is really bad for four months.
Agent: Shall I book you with the doctor tomorrow?
Customer: Okay fine, book me tomorrow at 4.
Agent: Done, your consultation is booked for tomorrow, Saturday, at 4 PM at Cedar Square.
Customer: Okay, I'll come.

Agent: Hello sir, Aster Vale Care. You enquired about sciatica?
Customer: Yes, the pain goes down my leg for two months. I want the treatment but my wife decides these things, I need to discuss with her first.
Agent: Sure. When should I call you back?
Customer: Call me Monday.
Agent: Okay, Monday morning?
Customer: No, make it Tuesday evening. Monday I'm busy the whole day.
Agent: Okay sir, Tuesday evening I'll call you.
Customer: Okay.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Care. You enquired about knee pain?
Customer: Yes, for my mother, she is 64, knee pain for a year.
Agent: The doctor is available this week. When would you like to come?
Customer: Not this week. Book it for the 20th, at 11 in the morning.
Agent: Done ma'am, consultation confirmed on the 20th at 11 AM.
Customer: Okay, thank you.

Agent: Hello sir, Aster Vale Care. You enquired about your back pain.
Customer: Yes, but I've read about your procedures. I don't want any injection-based treatment.
Agent: Sir, not all are injections, the doctor will decide after examination.
Customer: No, I have decided. I'm not interested in your clinic's treatment. Final.
Agent: Okay sir.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Care. You enquired about shoulder pain?
Customer: Yes, my right shoulder hurts for three months. I want to know about the treatment.
Agent: Sure, I can explain the options and the doctor's timings.
Customer: I can't talk properly right now. Call me in two hours.
Agent: Sure ma'am, I'll call you in two hours.
Customer: Okay.

Agent: Hello sir, Aster Vale Care, about your knee pain.
Customer: Yes, both knees pain for a year. How much does the treatment cost?
Agent: Consultation is 1000 and procedures start from 10,000.
Customer: That's a lot for me right now. I'll have to arrange the money first.
Agent: When should I call you back?
Customer: Call me next Friday.
Agent: Okay sir, next Friday I'll call you.
Customer: Okay.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Care, about your neck pain enquiry.
Customer: Yes, neck pain for some months.
Agent: The doctor can see you tomorrow or Thursday.
Customer: I'll think about it. Maybe call me Thursday.
Agent: Ma'am, I'll share the doctor's details on WhatsApp, please go through them. Thank you, have a good evening.

Agent: Hello sir, Aster Vale Care. You enquired for back pain?
Customer: Haan, back pain for eight months. Abhi physiotherapy chal rahi hai, it finishes this week. After that I'll decide.
Agent: Okay sir. Shall I call you parso?
Customer: Haan, parso shaam ko call karna.
Agent: Theek hai sir, parso evening I'll call you.
Customer: Theek hai.

Agent: Hello ma'am, Aster Vale Care, about your hip pain.
Customer: Yes, hip pain for six months, it's getting worse.
Agent: Shall I book you with Dr. Mira on Wednesday, the 14th, at 3 PM?
Customer: Yes, Wednesday 3 PM is fine.
Agent: Booked. I will also call you tomorrow at 11 to confirm the details.
Customer: Haan, okay.
